assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: destroyed building and debris production sprites for the existing painted 2D side-scrolling aviation game. EDIT TARGET / MATCHING REFERENCE: the supplied original project's building atlas. Make a matching DESTROYED version of ALL EIGHT buildings, preserving their exact column/row identity and horizontal footprint. Genuine transparent background PNG, 1536x1024, FOUR columns TWO rows, cells384x512. Every sprite isolated inside its cell, grounded at y450 top row / y962 lower row. Top row left to right: collapsed timber/canvas aircraft hangar, collapsed snowy timber hangar, shattered arched brick hangar, destroyed stone manor. Bottom: wrecked snow-covered rail depot, collapsed civic clock tower, ruined twin-chimney redbrick factory, devastated mountain stone mill and broken waterwheel. Ruins retain width of the intact building and stand roughly 25–45% of intact height; torn beams, broken masonry walls, crumpled roofs, small patches glowing embers, dust and loose rubble. They are clearly bombed-out buildings sitting ON the ground, never intact buildings shrunken vertically or sunken underground. Keep the entire solid ground baseline common. No smoke plumes, no large flames, text, scenery, ground plane or labels. Include 3 to 5 small separate flying debris fragments in otherwise empty upper part of EACH cell (bricks, broken timber, roof tiles, twisted metal), spaced well away from the grounded ruin so they can be separately cropped for animation. Painterly high-detail Amiga-adventure visual language matching the reference, not blocky pixel art. Leave at least 12px clear gutters between columns. Preserve transparent alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production aviation-game sidebar button sprite sheet. Style reference only: supplied own cockpit panel, use its warm aged brass, polished screws, leather and charcoal enamel. Generate a new genuinely transparent 1536x1024 PNG, EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows (cells 384x512). Exactly eight isolated SQUARE 320x320 buttons centered in cells: centres x192,576,960,1344; y256 and768. All eight have the SAME square chamfered brass rim, four screw heads, charcoal-black textured enamel face, soft warm edge highlights, clean recognizable ivory/bronze raised pictogram at centre. No background, no extra objects, no captions or alphabet text. Top row left-to-right: PAUSE two ivory vertical bars; RESUME single ivory right-pointing triangle; SOUND ON brass speaker with 3 ivory sound-wave arcs; SOUND OFF muted grey speaker with clear ivory small X. Bottom row left-to-right: CONTROLS open ivory flight instruction book with small question mark; SETTINGS a centred detailed brass gear and short small spanner; FULLSCREEN four ivory outward corner brackets; HOME stylized aviation hangar roof and doorway. Icons bold enough to read at 46 pixels. Painted detailed adventure-game graphics, no coarse pixel art, no flat vector icons, no bright flat yellow arcade tiles. Buttons must not touch or cross cell boundaries, preserve transparent alpha and identical alignment.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D painted aviation game faction flag mounting sprites / three visual proposals. Reference image supplied is this project's own building atlas, style reference only; render NO buildings. Transparent 1536x1024 PNG, exactly THREE columns TWO rows, six isolated fixtures within 512x512 cells. Each cell shows only ONE national cloth flag and its realistic mounting, no labels. Top row British Union Jack flags (accurate red/white/blue diagonal and upright crosses). Bottom row Imperial German black-white-red horizontal tricolour flags, black upper band, white middle, red bottom, absolutely no swastikas or modern emblems. Column A: a short vertical rooftop flagpole with finial, sturdy metal roof bracket at bottom, cloth flying to the right, full fixture occupies x100..440 y60..450 in each cell. Column B: a diagonal upward wall-mounted flagstaff rising from lower-left mounting bracket toward upper-right, cloth flag hangs and flutters to the right, full fixture kept inside x45..460 y80..430. Column C: a rectangular cloth wall flag hanging from a short horizontal brass top rail with small ropes, gentle fabric folds, x80..440 y90..430. Warm painted high-detail adventure-game graphics matching the supplied original project, natural cloth movement and readable simple national colours at small size. Make metal and fabric look physically attached to each other. No backdrop, ground shadows, scenery, buildings, letters or text. Wide clear gutters between fixtures; retain real transparent alpha.
